dog.definition: A domesticated animal often kept on a farm for guarding or companionship.
dog.exampleUsage: The dog was identified during the lesson.

cat.definition: A small domesticated animal that may live on a farm.
cat.exampleUsage: The cat was identified during the lesson.

rabbit.definition: Any of various burrowing animals of the family Leporidae having long ears and short tails.
rabbit.exampleUsage: The rabbit was identified during the lesson.

hamster.definition: Short-tailed Old World burrowing rodent with large cheek pouches.

parrot.definition: Usually brightly colored zygodactyl tropical birds with short hooked beaks and the ability to mimic sounds.
parrot.exampleUsage: The parrot was identified during the lesson.

turtle.definition: A slow-moving animal with a hard shell.
turtle.exampleUsage: The turtle was identified during the lesson.

guinea-pig.definition: A small domesticated rodent often kept as a pet.
guinea-pig.exampleUsage: The guinea pig waited in a secure carrier.

fish.definition: An animal caught with a fishing line or net.
fish.exampleUsage: The fish was identified during the lesson.

snake.definition: Something long, thin, and flexible that resembles a snake.

ferret.definition: Musteline mammal of prairie regions of United States.
ferret.exampleUsage: The ferret was identified during the lesson.

stethoscope.definition: A medical instrument for listening to the sounds generated inside the body.

scale.definition: A device that measures how heavy a person or object is.

otoscope.definition: Medical instrument consisting of a magnifying lens and light.

x-ray.definition: In biology, a ray is a sea fish with a flat body and broad fins.
x-ray.exampleUsage: The x ray was identified during the lesson.

blood-test.definition: Analysis of a blood sample can reveal, measure, or track substances, cells, and other signs of how the body is working.

microscope.definition: Magnifier of the image of small objects.

syringe.definition: To spray or irrigate (a body part) with a syringe.

bandage.definition: To dress by covering or binding.

vaccination.definition: Taking a vaccine as a precaution against contracting a disease.

surgery.definition: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments.

dental-cleaning.definition: A professional cleaning procedure that removes plaque and tartar from an animal's teeth, usually performed by veterinary staff.
dental-cleaning.exampleUsage: The veterinarian discussed whether the pet needed dental cleaning.

microchip.definition: Electronic equipment consisting of a small crystal of a silicon semiconductor fabricated to carry out a number of electronic functions in an integrated circuit.

neuter.definition: Neither male nor female (of grammatical gender).

medication.definition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease.

stitches.definition: Threads or other materials used by a medical professional to close a wound or surgical cut.
stitches.exampleUsage: The veterinarian checked that the stitches were healing normally.

cast.definition: The distinctive form in which a thing is made.

cone-collar.definition: A cone-shaped protective collar worn by an animal to stop it licking or biting a wound.
cone-collar.exampleUsage: The dog wore a cone collar after treatment.

waiting-room.definition: A room where clients and animals wait before being seen by veterinary staff.
waiting-room.exampleUsage: The cat stayed in its carrier in the waiting room.

exam-table.definition: A raised table used to support an animal during a veterinary examination.
exam-table.exampleUsage: The vet gently examined the puppy on the exam table.

operating-room.definition: A specially equipped hospital room is used for surgery and kept sterile to reduce the risk of infection.

pharmacy.definition: The art and science of preparing and dispensing drugs and medicines.

reception.definition: The manner in which something is greeted.

lab.definition: A workplace for the conduct of scientific research.

recovery-room.definition: A hospital room where patients are monitored and cared for after surgery.

grooming-area.definition: A designated space for washing, brushing, trimming, or other pet-grooming tasks.
grooming-area.exampleUsage: The clinic has a separate grooming area.

outdoor-run.definition: A secure outdoor enclosure where an animal can move around for exercise.
outdoor-run.exampleUsage: The boarding area includes a secure outdoor run.

carrier.definition: Someone whose employment involves carrying something.

treats.definition: To subject to a process or treatment, with the aim of readying for some purpose, improving, or remedying a condition.

food-bowl.definition: A container used to hold food for an animal.
food-bowl.exampleUsage: The dog's food bowl was washed after the meal.

water-dish.definition: A shallow container kept filled with water so animals can drink from it.
water-dish.exampleUsage: The water dish was identified during the lesson.

tag.definition: A label written or printed on paper, cardboard, or plastic that is attached to something to indicate its owner, nature, price, etc.

nail-clippers.definition: A tool used for trimming fingernails and toenails.

brush.definition: A cleaning tool with many stiff hairs attached to a handle or base.

veterinarian.definition: A doctor who practices veterinary medicine.

vet-tech.definition: A trained veterinary technician who assists veterinarians with animal care and clinical tasks.
vet-tech.exampleUsage: The vet tech prepared the examination room.

receptionist.definition: A secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone and receive visitors.

groomer.definition: A person, machine, or animal that cleans, brushes, or arranges another organism’s coat, fur, feathers, or skin. In the life sciences, the term also describes an agent involved in grooming behavior or animal care.
groomer.exampleUsage: The groomer was identified during the lesson.

kennel-attendant.definition: A worker who feeds, cleans, monitors, and cares for animals kept in kennels.
kennel-attendant.exampleUsage: The kennel attendant refreshed the animals' water.

surgeon.definition: A physician who specializes in surgery.

specialist.definition: An expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning.

intern.definition: A student or trainee working temporarily to gain experience.

volunteer.definition: A person who freely helps without being paid.

pet-owner.definition: A person who owns and is responsible for a companion animal.
pet-owner.exampleUsage: The pet owner described the cat's recent behavior to the vet.
